title: Frontend-initiated Codex/Claude sign-in
description:
## Context
Seer's assistant features (card Ask/Edit, change requests) require the local bridge (bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs) to find an authenticated Codex CLI or Claude Code login on the bridge host. When neither is signed in, the web UI dead-ends with a static notice ('No assistant model is available...') in two places (question-panel and inbox), and the user must SSH to the bridge host and run CLI logins in a terminal.

Goal: initiate AND complete provider sign-in from the Seer web UI, preserving the README security posture: Seer never stores OpenAI/Anthropic credentials; they stay in the CLI credential stores on the bridge host.

Verified facts (2026-08-31):
- `codex login --device-auth` exists (RFC 8628 device flow: verification URL + user code, completable from any device; CLI polls until authorized).
- `claude auth login|logout|status` and `claude setup-token` exist; Claude flows are Ink/interactive -> TTY risk when spawned headless.
- Bridge runProcess() buffers stdout until child exit -> cannot supervise interactive logins (bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs ~548-572).
- Model catalog refresh is timer-based (catalogRefreshMs) -> even manual logins surface slowly.
- Ship-side worker-claim queue pattern exists 3x (card-questions, change-requests, model registry): %pending/%working/.../%failed + worker=@t claims.

## Scope
IN: login-request queue in ship state; MCP tool surface; bridge interactive supervisor (Codex device-auth first); frontend sign-in panel (no-JS capable); Claude paste-back path; provider status + logout.
OUT: API-key entry through the frontend (explicit anti-goal: would move credentials through ship state / event log); QR rendering (tracked as deferred P3).

## Success Criteria
- From a logged-out bridge host, a user completes Codex sign-in entirely from /apps/seer (except the provider's own OAuth page); models publish within one poll of completion.
- Claude sign-in completes via paste-back from the frontend.
- No provider credential material remains in current ship state after completion (one-time codes cleared; event-log residue documented).
- Flow works without JavaScript (plain form posts + full-page renders).

## Risks
- CLI stdout wording is not a stable API -> fixture-tested exported parsers, fail soft to %failed with raw tail.
- Claude TTY requirement -> script -qec pseudo-TTY wrapper; Codex-only ships value alone.
- Device/paste codes transit the event log -> one-time, minutes-lived, cleared from current state.
- Bridge restart mid-login -> startup sweep fails orphaned claims; UI offers retry.

## Deployment note
Verify on a scratch fakeship (pattern: /tmp/seer-qa; boot with the seer-dev-ship vere binary, |new-desk/|mount/|commit/|install). Do NOT rsync into or commit on the piers under ~/projects without Jake's explicit approval.
close_reason: Core frontend Codex/Claude authentication, secure nonce/HMAC bridge protocol, responsive state-aware UI, provider status/logout, real MCP transport, shutdown handling, and terminal-state E2E checks are complete. QR child remains explicitly deferred and out of core scope.

title: Define login-request type and migrate state to %9
description:
## Goal
Add the login-request data model and ship-state migration so every other piece can type against it.

## Context
Foundation of the sign-in epic. Mirrors the three existing worker-claim queues (card-questions, change-requests, model registry).

## Technical Details
- Files: desk/sur/seer.hoon, desk/app/seer.hoon
- New type in sur:
  +$ login-status $?(%pending %working %challenge %done %failed)
  +$ login-request [id=@tas provider=ai-provider status=login-status auth-url=@t user-code=@t pasted-code=@t message=@t worker=@t created-at=@da updated-at=@da]
- New action variants: %request-login [id provider], %claim-login [id worker], %post-login-challenge [id worker auth-url user-code], %submit-login-code [id code], %finish-login [id worker], %fail-login [id worker message], %retry-login [id], %cancel-login [id]
- app/seer.hoon: versioned-state gains [%9 state-eight]; state-eight = state-seven + logins=(map @tas login-request); on-load cases %0-%8 fill logins with ~. Follow the existing migration ladder exactly (see the %5/%6 conversion cases around lines 229-300).
- Check the %x %ai-state scry / ai-state sur type: decide whether logins joins it (NEVER include pasted-code there).

## Edge Cases
- Do not break existing marks (seer-action mark must round-trip the new variants).

## Testing
Scratch fakeship: |commit + |install cleanly; dojo-poke %request-login; :seer +dbug shows the request; agent reload preserves it.

## Dependencies
None.
notes: Add state v10 with bridge capability hash set only through local poke-noun; never scry raw capability. Add consume-login-code action clearing pasted code.
close_reason: Final v11 security state: local-only bridge secret plus nonce->issued-at map; issue prunes >5m; protected actions verify HMAC-SHA256 over action/id/worker/nonce/all mutable fields, atomically delete nonce, reject missing/expired/replayed proofs. No auth verifier scry.

comments.text: Reopened: Security redesign: worker_id equality is not authentication. Add local-only pre-shared bridge capability, redact pasted codes, one-shot consume, and provider URL allowlist before UI/bridge wiring.

title: Handle login lifecycle pokes in seer agent
description:
## Goal
Implement the 8 login action handlers in poke-seer-action with the established guard discipline.

## Context
The queue's semantics live here: idempotency, worker equality, secret hygiene.

## Technical Details
- File: desk/app/seer.hoon (poke-seer-action)
- %request-login: idempotent (same id+provider -> no-op, matching the 'already-exists' convention); reject a second active (%pending/%working/%challenge) request for the same provider; prune stale %done/%failed for that provider on new request.
- %claim-login: only from %pending; records worker; sets %working.
- %post-login-challenge / %finish-login / %fail-login: require worker equality with the claim (mirror the %answer-card-question guard, app/seer.hoon ~1489-1501).
- %finish-login: sets %done AND clears auth-url/user-code/pasted-code to '' (one-time secrets must not persist in current state; event-log residue is accepted and documented).
- %submit-login-code: allowed only in %challenge; stores pasted-code for the bridge to read.
- %cancel-login: any active state -> %failed with message 'cancelled'; %retry-login: %failed -> %pending with cleared worker/message.

## Edge Cases
- %finish-login must never be reachable without a matching worker claim (planning MCP clients must not be able to fabricate success).

## Testing
Dojo pokes through the full lifecycle; wrong-worker pokes rejected; state after %finish-login contains no code/url text.

## Dependencies
srrs-login-state (types).
close_reason: Protected claim/post/finish/fail/consume actions now require nonce+proof; each consumes nonce only after state/worker/proof guards. One-shot code remains redacted from general list. Full app direct-build passes.

title: Add interactive child supervisor and device-auth parsers to bridge
description:
## Goal
Bridge can run long-lived interactive login children: incremental stdout parsing, later stdin writes, cancellation, timeouts.

## Context
runProcess() (bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs ~548-572) buffers until exit -- unusable for logins where the URL/code must be extracted MID-flight while the child keeps polling the provider.

## Technical Details
- File: bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs (+ tests in bridge/seer-ai-bridge.test.mjs)
- runInteractive(command, args, {env, onOutput, timeoutMs}) -> handle {child, write(text), kill()}; registry Map keyed by login-request id; timeout ~15min then SIGTERM -> SIGKILL 5s later (mirror runProcess timer).
- Export pure parseCodexDeviceAuth(accumulatedBuffer) -> {url, code} | null. Parse the ACCUMULATED buffer each chunk (chunk boundaries can split lines). Strip ANSI escapes first.
- Env hygiene: delete OPENAI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (existing pattern, see codexLoggedIn ~191-204).
- This is pure JS with no ship dependency -- fully parallelizable with the Hoon work.

## Edge Cases
- Child prints URL and code on separate chunks/lines; ANSI color noise; CRLF.
- Parser failure must not throw: caller fails the request soft with the raw tail (safeError pattern).

## Testing
node --test bridge/seer-ai-bridge.test.mjs with fixtures: realistic `codex login --device-auth` output, split-chunk delivery, ANSI noise. Capture a real fixture from the bridge host CLI when possible.

## Dependencies
None (parallel-safe from day one).
close_reason: Exported stripAnsi, parseCodexDeviceAuth (HTTPS/host constrained), and runInteractive (incremental bounded output, later stdin writes, timeout SIGTERM->SIGKILL, explicit kill/end, deterministic completion). Added split-chunk/ANSI/adversarial URL and real child stdin tests. node --test: 18/18 pass.

title: Wire login processing into bridge poll loop
description:
## Goal
Consume the queue end-to-end for Codex device-auth; publish models immediately on success.

## Context
poll() (~751-763) currently lists questions+changes. Success must not wait for catalogRefreshMs (main loop ~776-785) -- users are staring at the panel.

## Technical Details
- File: bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs
- poll(): add seer/list-login-requests. For %pending codex requests: seer/claim-login -> runInteractive(codexCmd, ["login","--device-auth"]) -> when parseCodexDeviceAuth yields -> seer/post-login-challenge {auth_url, user_code} -> on child exit 0 -> seer/finish-login -> IMMEDIATELY resolveProviders + discoverModelProfiles + publishModelProfiles -> log. Nonzero exit/timeout -> seer/fail-login with safeError text.
- Startup sweep: on boot, fail any request claimed by this workerId still %working/%challenge (no live child exists after restart).
- Cancellation: if a listed request turned %failed/%done/absent while a child runs, kill the child.
- --once mode must kill live children before exit; never orphan.

## Testing
Scratch fakeship + logged-out codex on the bridge host: full flow from web-created request to published models. Restart bridge mid-login: request flips %failed and is retryable.

## Dependencies
srrs-login-supervisor, srrs-login-mcp.
close_reason: Shutdown hardening complete: SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers set shutdown flag and immediately terminate interactive children; main exits loop and bounded-drains tasks, escalates SIGKILL after timeout; fatal path also drains. Cancellation test proves SIGTERM delivery, task settlement, fail-state cleanup, and empty registry. 25/25 tests pass.

comments.author: jake
comments.text: Reopened: Security hardening: login child errors currently inherit runInteractive stdout/stderr and could persist device URL/code via fail-login. Replace with fixed sanitized login failure messages and test log/state non-disclosure.

comments.author: jake
comments.text: Reopened: Shutdown hardening: wire active interactive children into SIGINT/SIGTERM cancellation and bounded task drain; add cancellation test.

title: Add login action routes and render plumbing
description:
## Goal
Web forms can drive the login queue; the renderer receives login state.

## Context
All Seer UI actions are POST routes decoding form fields into typed %seer-action pokes (app/seer.hoon poke-handle-http-request, ~615-880).

## Technical Details
- File: desk/app/seer.hoon
- POST routes: /apps/seer/actions/request-login (field: provider; server derives id, e.g. login-codex / login-claude), /actions/submit-login-code (fields: login-id, code), /actions/cancel-login, /actions/retry-login. Use apply-web-action with notice ~. Accept a 'return' field to decide the re-rendered page, mirroring ask-card (~833-877) -- the panel appears on both review and inbox surfaces.
- render-page passes logins.state into render:index; render signature gains the map (mirror how `changes` is threaded; single call site at ~977).

## Testing
curl form posts on a scratch fakeship advance the request through its states; render receives logins (temporary debug print or panel from the sibling task).

## Dependencies
srrs-login-pokes.
notes: Security prerequisite closed. Routes already implemented; renderer signature includes logins map. Verify then close.
close_reason: Added request/submit-code/cancel/retry HTTP routes with review/inbox return handling; render-page passes logins map and renderer accepts it. Verified real authenticated POST on scratch ship returned 200 and created %login-claude in state.

title: Render sign-in panel replacing no-model notices
description:
## Goal
Turn both dead-end 'No assistant model is available' notices into an actionable, state-aware sign-in panel.

## Context
Two placements: question-panel-body (desk/app/seer/index.hoon ~1509) and inbox-page (~534). House rules: server-rendered sail, works without JS, HTMX polling as enhancement only. Reuse the established UI machinery: thinking-indicator arm, conditional hx-trigger polling (question-panel waiting wrapper ~1468-1476), failure + retry row (question-row %failed ~1600-1623), pill/panel tokens.

## Technical Details
- File: desk/app/seer/index.hoon
- New arm (login-panel logins): 
  - no active request -> two buttons: 'Sign in to Codex' / 'Sign in to Claude Code' (forms posting request-login with provider + return fields).
  - %pending/%working -> thinking-indicator ('Waiting for the local bridge...') inside a section polling every 2s while active only.
  - %challenge -> verification URL as a link (target _blank, rel noopener) + user code in a large copyable mono block (new .login-code style: ~1.3rem mono, letter-spacing, generous tap padding, light+dark tokens); for claude requests additionally a one-field paste form posting submit-login-code; a Cancel button.
  - %failed -> message + 'Try again' / 'Dismiss' forms (retry-login / cancel-login).
- Hide the panel entirely when models exist (models list wins over any stale request).
- Both placements call the same arm; inbox copy may differ slightly (context line).

## Edge Cases
- No-JS: every state must be reachable by full-page form posts alone.
- Mobile: code block and buttons at thumb sizes (>=3rem targets), safe-area padding already handled by the shell.

## Testing
Browser pass on a scratch fakeship: desktop+mobile, light+dark, all four states (fake states by dojo-poking the lifecycle); no-JS flow with polling disabled.

## Dependencies
srrs-login-routes.
notes: Resolved: direct -build-file bisection proved Hoon failure came from miclus splicing raw @t and direct arm returns in narrowed Sail contexts. Final component compiles and browser QA passes.
close_reason: Terminal-state rendering fixed: request selection prioritizes active login/logout jobs; polling only pending/working/challenge; %done/%failed derive UI from provider-connected model truth. Real renderer tests: login done+model => Connected/Sign out + poll none; logout done+no model => Sign in + poll none. Hoon direct build passes.

title: Support Claude paste-back sign-in in bridge
description:
## Goal
Claude Code sign-in from the frontend via URL + paste-back code.

## Context
Claude's CLI is Ink-based; `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token` may refuse or garble output without a TTY. This is the epic's main technical risk -- SPIKE FIRST, and note Codex-only already ships value if this stalls.

## Technical Details
- File: bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs (+ test fixtures)
- Spike: run both commands with piped stdio on the bridge host. If TTY-required, wrap: script -qec "claude setup-token" /dev/null (util-linux, no new deps) and strip ANSI in the parser.
- Prefer setup-token (long-lived token; requires Claude subscription); confirm claudeLoggedIn() (~206-218, `claude auth status` JSON .loggedIn) recognizes its result -- fall back to `claude auth login` if not.
- Flow: spawn -> parseClaudeAuthChallenge(buffer) -> {url} -> post-login-challenge (no user code; paste-back direction is user->bridge) -> poll list until pasted_code appears -> handle.write(code + newline) -> success (exit 0 or auth status flips) -> finish-login + immediate catalog republish.
- Wrong code -> child errors -> fail-login with sanitized message; codes cleared from state by %finish/%fail (ship side).

## Testing
Fixtures for ANSI-heavy output; end-to-end on the bridge host with claude logged out.

## Dependencies
srrs-login-bridge-loop, srrs-login-panel.
close_reason: Implemented persistent Claude  through 1024-col pseudo-TTY, allowlisted challenge parser, signed challenge/consume/finish lifecycle, one-shot paste code stdin delivery, immediate catalog refresh, sanitized failures. Real CLI probe confirmed PTY requirement and unwrapped 702-char URL. Integration test covers waiting->consumed code and finish. 23/23 tests pass.

title: Surface provider signed-in status and logout
description:
## Goal
Panel shows who is signed in per provider and offers sign-out; stale-login failures stop being opaque.

## Context
After sign-in works, trust needs visibility: 'Codex - signed in (Pro)' beats an unexplained model list. `codex login status` prints account info; `claude auth status` returns JSON.

## Technical Details
- Files: bridge/seer-ai-bridge.mjs, desk/sur/seer.hoon, desk/lib/seer-mcp.hoon, desk/lib/seer-json.hoon, desk/app/seer/index.hoon, desk/app/seer.hoon
- Bridge publish cycle reports provider status alongside models (small new tool seer/report-provider-status {provider, signed_in, label} or extend the register payload).
- Privacy: prefer plan tier/provider name over e-mail; e-mail optional and off by default.
- %request-logout action + route + panel button -> bridge runs `codex logout` / `claude auth logout` -> immediate republish (models empty -> panel returns to sign-in state).

## Testing
Status line matches CLI truth on the bridge host; logout empties models within one poll.

## Dependencies
srrs-login-bridge-loop, srrs-login-panel.
notes: Additional terminal-state E2E evidence: done login with model renders connected idle; done logout after catalog clear renders signed-out idle. Logout bridge flow and UI verified.
close_reason: Provider-aware Inbox connections use actual model catalog: signed-out shows Sign in; connected shows Connected + Sign out. request-logout queues signed logout job; bridge runs codex logout / claude auth logout with nonce proofs, verifies status false, finishes and refreshes catalog. Polling is 'none' idle and every 2s only with active request. Hoon direct build, live model registration UI, and real logout queue request verified; JS tests 24/24.

title: QR code for device-auth verification URL
description:
## Status: DEFERRED BY DEFAULT
Do not pick this up without an explicit request from Jake.

## Goal
Render the device-auth verification URL as a QR code for phone hand-off.

## Context
Cross-device sign-in means retyping a short URL. Value is modest: the URL is short (activation page + code) and the code block is already copyable. No QR encoder exists in-desk; this needs a lib/qr.hoon port (or a build-time asset approach). Cost was judged to outweigh benefit (analysis 2026-08-31).

## Technical Details (if ever picked up)
- Files: desk/lib/qr.hoon (new), desk/app/seer/index.hoon
- Pure-hoon QR encoding (byte mode, EC level L) rendered as inline SVG in the %challenge state.

## Dependencies
srrs-login-panel.
notes: Deferred by design; do not start without explicit Jake request. Also blocked by .7.
